title: Use a food inventory to guide meal planning
summary: Check food already available and its storage needs before shopping. Track discarded food separately before estimating costs or impact.
content:
Before planning meals or shopping, check the food already available and note items that need to be used soon. Store food according to its label and safe handling guidance. Keep a short log of food discarded, including the item and whether it was edible.

A grocery bill does not reveal how much food is wasted. Do not apply an assumed waste percentage to spending or present an unmeasured reduction as a saving.
applicability_conditions: Records grocery spending or wants to reduce avoidable food disposal
implementation_steps: Check pantry and refrigerator before shopping
Plan meals around items that need to be used soon
Record discarded food over a representative week
Separate edible food from unavoidable preparation waste
limitations: Food safety and storage requirements depend on the item
No food-waste fraction, cost saving, or emissions estimate is assumed
